items.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
items.blurb: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator.

items.title: Introducing Workers KV Instant — powered by Quicksilver
items.blurb: Workers KV Instant delivers sub-2ms p99 read latencies and 250ms global replication across Cloudflare’s 300+ edge locations. KV Instant eliminates cold-read penalties and uses the familiar Workers KV API.

items.title: Cloudflare OS: your company’s agent workspace, managed for you
items.blurb: Cloudflare OS gives everyone in your organization an agent workspace that knows how your company works and connects to its data and systems.

items.title: Announcing Cloudflare K2: serverless event streams
items.blurb: Cloudflare K2 is a serverless event streaming service built directly on top of R2 object storage for high-scale data movement and long-term retention.

items.title: We want you to build the next Git platform on Cloudflare
items.blurb: Cloudflare is hosting a competition to see who will build the next Git platform for an era of AI agents. Artifacts is in open beta, with Workers bindings, data jurisdiction controls, and event subscriptions for repository changes.

items.title: Improving site performance by shipping more CSS
items.blurb: How we fully migrated github.com away from CSS-in-JS. The post Improving site performance by shipping more CSS appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: Cursor Uses S3 WAL to Scale Git Storage to More than 300 Pushes per Second
items.blurb: Cursor has introduced Continuity, a Git storage architecture that uses an S3 backed write ahead log as the source of truth. The design turns local NVMe repositories into warm caches and separates replica coordination from consistency.

items.title: OUSD is now the default stablecoin on Stripe
items.blurb: Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin built for global money movement, is now available across Stripe. Businesses can use OUSD to manage funds, make payments, and offer new financial services.

items.title: 10 technical talks I’m excited about at GitHub Universe 2026
items.blurb: From verifying AI-written code to securing npm dependencies, these are the sessions I’m building my Universe agenda around. The post 10 technical talks I’m excited about at GitHub Universe 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: django-modern-rest@0.16.0 release
items.blurb: Hi everyone, I am the release manager of django-modern-rest :) django-modern-rest 0.16.0 is out! Is this your first time that you hear about this project?

items.title: Introducing Clef: our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
items.blurb: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows.

items.title: One year later: Sovereign AI and the fight for choice
items.blurb: AI sovereignty is not a zero-sum game, but many governments now believe it is. Cloudflare's answer: more local open-source models, model-agnostic security tools, and a commitment to giving nations genuine choice.
